name: E.T. the Extra-Trusting
tagline: The way home begins with a friend.
description: Pedal through a moonlit suburb with a small stranded visitor in your basket. Borrow transmitter parts, hide from searchlights, restore the woods, and follow a thread of starlight home, alone or with up to three friends.
controls: Left stick/WASD ride; right stick/right-drag camera; ×/E help; □/Q glow; ○/F candy; R2/Space boost; L2/Shift hush; △/Tab map; Options/Esc pause. Touch: left-thumb slide, right tap help, double-tap glow.
